edits.after: scope='Exploratory native-PDK sampler load-resistor length screen on frozen baseline wiring; candidate dimensions have NOT been laid out or freshly extracted. NOT actual candidate post-layout acceptance. Baseline MIM-aware model:

# Deliberate circuit-parameter experiment, never an assertion of changed-layout PEX.
        baseline_model=model;baseline_text=baseline_model.read_text();rows=parser.statements(baseline_text)
        targets={d['instance'] for d in contract['device_records'] if d['model']=='rppd' and parser.number(d['parameters']['w'])==Decimal('32e-6') and parser.number(d['parameters']['l'])==Decimal('2.12e-6')}
        assert len(targets)==16
        candidate_rows=[];changed=[]
        for row in rows:
            updated=list(row)
            if row[0] in targets:
                assert row[4]=='rppd'
                positions=[i for i,v in enumerate(row)if v.startswith('l=')];assert len(positions)==1
                i=positions[0];assert parser.number(row[i][2:])==Decimal('2.12e-6')
                updated[i]='l='+args.load_length_um+'u'
                assert all(x==y for j,(x,y)in enumerate(zip(row,updated,strict=True))if j!=i)
                changed.append(dict(instance=row[0],old_parameter=row[i],new_parameter=updated[i]))
            else:assert updated==row
            candidate_rows.append(updated)
        assert {d['instance']for d in changed}==targets and len(candidate_rows)==len(rows)
        model=out/'candidate-load-resistors.spice';model.write_text('\n'.join(' '.join(row)for row in candidate_rows)+'\n')
        r['load_resistor_screen']=dict(original_model_sha256=sha(baseline_model),candidate_model_sha256=sha(model),changes=changed,wire_geometry='Frozen local-v5 baseline; no regenerated candidate layout or RC',all_other_model_cards_and_nodes_unchanged=True,actual_candidate_layout_verified=False,original_acceptance_gates_unchanged=True)
        save()
        fetch(pump.BASE+'cloud-results-39029337682-1-pll-pump-current/pll-pump-current-39029337682-1.summary.json',primitive.SUMMARY,out/'models-pin.json')
